claims_excluded: hard real-time bound beyond the frozen finite windows

decision.fail_or_unknown: any mismatch, absent hook entry, uncertain call ID, completed dispatch before cancel, extra dispatch/cancel/recovery, unknown release/readback, timeout, effect mismatch, or incomplete cleanup; preserve raw and do not rerun.
decision.pass: exactly one dispatch and one cancel; observed generation matches owned fixture; hook confirms injected Q-down inside callback; public cancel returns without error within 1000ms while dispatch task is pending; final same-call result shows recovered cancellation bound to the same operation/generation, exact producer exit before one recovery UP, independent same-generation all-up readback within 2500ms and after callback release; saved fixture effect and exact pre-cancel journal match; hook, fixture, session and child cleanup are confirmed.

host: user-authorized local Windows PC; one owned fixture process/window
hypothesis: A public stdio MCP dispatch blocked inside the real Win32 SendInput path by one injected Q-down hook callback can be cancelled by exact call ID; the producer is retired before one same-generation supervised release and independent all-up readback, while a previously saved fixture effect remains independently observable.
resource_boundary: Only this PC and one owned fixture. Only VK_Q is delayed by the probe-owned hook; release callback immediately after cancel response. No WSLc or Docker. Restore the foreground HWND captured before fixture creation.
retry_policy: one validation, at most one dispatch and exactly one cancel after verified hook entry; no fallback input, replay, retry, or rerun

admission.target_generation: exact generation returned by this attempt public interface_observe

trial.cancel: one public interface_cancel for the exact dispatch call_id; no second cancel
trial.effect_order: fixture click, sentinel text and CTRL+S save happen before the Q-down cancellation point; task effect is read independently after the recovery flow.

native_stimulus.hook: one WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook in the probe process
native_stimulus.release: immediately after interface_cancel returns; callback has a fixed 1500ms self-release cap

trial.target: one fresh owned fixture_app process/window; call ID discovered from its persisted request.json, then used exactly once for interface_cancel
